onboarding.interestsHint: Pick at least three topics. Your feed fills with the reviews that talk about them, even if you know nobody here yet.
onboarding.followHint: The ones who publish the most. You can unfollow whenever you want.
onboarding.followEmpty: Nobody to suggest yet. Your feed will fill with the topics you picked.
onboarding.doneHint: Your feed is built. All that is missing is your first review: a link, what you think of it, and the conversation starts.

auth.loginPitch: Your views, your voice. Pick the conversation up where you left it and see what the community shared while you were away.
auth.loginQuote: "YOWL has become my reflex before every discovery on the web."
auth.verified: Email verified. You can now sign in.
auth.forgotIntro: No panic. Give us your email address and we will send you a link to reset your password.
auth.forgotSentHint: A reset link is on its way. Remember to check your spam folder.
auth.signupPitch: Share your unfiltered views on anything on the web, with a community of 13 to 35 year olds like you.
auth.ageRule: The community is open to 13 to 35 year olds
auth.verifyHint: The code is valid for 15 minutes. Remember to check your spam folder.
auth.perkUnlimited: Publish as many reviews as you like

tag.notFoundHint: This topic does not exist or has no reviews yet.
tag.emptyHint: Be the first to post here.
tag.directoryHint: Every topic has its own page and feed. Follow the ones you care about, they will fill your personalised feed.

appeal.title: My appeals
appeal.intro: When one of your texts is hidden, you can ask for a second look. A moderator reads it again and answers you in writing.
appeal.emptyHint: That is rather good news: nothing you wrote has been taken down.
appeal.waiting: Waiting for a second look. Appeals are handled in the order they arrive.
appeal.dialogIntro: Explain why you think this text should have stayed up. A moderator reads it again and answers you, whatever the conclusion.
appeal.placeholder: For instance: the flagged passage quotes an article, it is not a view I hold myself.
appeal.rules: Twenty characters minimum. One appeal per piece of content.
appeal.tooShort: Twenty characters at least, so the review has something to go on.
appeal.mistake: Do you think this decision is a mistake?

data.title: My data
data.intro: Everything the platform keeps about you, in a single file you can keep or take elsewhere.
data.downloadedHint: The file is in your downloads.
data.failed: The export could not be prepared.

compose.previewLater: The preview is fetched once published.
compose.duplicateOne: This link is already discussed here
compose.duplicateMany: This link is already discussed in {count} places
compose.duplicateHint: Joining the existing conversation gives it more reach than opening a second one.
compose.scheduleHint: The review stays out of the feed until then, to the nearest five minutes. You find it under "My reviews" in the meantime.
compose.contentPlaceholder: Share your view with the community...
compose.linkHint: The page on the web you are talking about
compose.imagesDrop: Click or drop your images here
compose.tagsPlaceholder: Add a tag, then Enter or comma

security.title: Security
security.intro: Your password protects your account. Change it if you think somebody else knows it.
security.mismatch: The two entries do not match.
security.otherDevices: Your other devices will be signed out.
security.failed: The change could not be saved.

suggest.receivedHint: Your suggestion reached the team inbox. It will be read, and if it is taken up you will see it in a future version.
suggest.title: Suggest an idea
suggest.intro: A missing feature, something that does not work, content to correct: write it here. The team running YOWL reads this, not the community.
suggest.reportInstead: on the review or comment concerned, which alerts moderation directly.
suggest.signedIn: You are signed in: your account is already attached to this message, nothing to fill in.
suggest.emailOptional: Optional. Without an address, your suggestion will be read but stay unanswered.
suggest.placeholder: Describe your idea. A concrete example helps a lot.
suggest.bePrecise: Be as precise as you can
